newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: APPLE FIELDS' VALENTINE RESIGNS AS CHAIR.
newsitem.headline: APPLE FIELDS' VALENTINE RESIGNS AS CHAIR.

text.p: Property developer Apple Fields Ltd said on Thursday Murray Valentine had stepped down as chairman and a member of its board.
John Robertson, who has been an executive director of the company for the past three months, will take over the chairmanship of the company and also continue his executive role.
Valentine said his primary attention needed to be focused on Tourism Holdings Ltd.

"I am investing a large part of my time on Tourism Holdings. Apple Fields has its new direction. It is appropriate that I depart from the company now that the company is out of the apple business, has disposed of its non-core investment in Dairy Brands and is beginning to develop its property assets," Valentine said.
Apple Fields announced earlier this year it would move out of apple growing and refocus as a property development company.
